attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The jade sculpture at Lantern Hill is currently drawing the attention of traders.","severity":"minor","reason":"places the sculpture at Lantern Hill; briefing says it is Gladwater's sculpture, talked about by Lantern Hill traders"},{"span":"They seem to be keeping busy with their trade fair, as I reported last time.","severity":"minor","reason":"ongoing activity inferred about the fair, though hedged with 'seem' and marked as old news"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The lead misattributes the sculpture to Lantern Hill instead of Gladwater, which muddles the one new fact, and the second item is thin filler with only a weak joke.
